text: No ads is a definite bonus and I enjoy the extra games that help to build up the players' armory. I'd find it far better and less frustrating if the last level of each side game / quest (cube blast, fairground, hill climb, Pearls of Atlantis etc) always included one new gold card. I've been left with 9 gold cards to collect before and it's impossible to collect them from standard packs. You can spend 500 stars on a chest with a guaranteed new card but it takes so long, I'm losing interest!

Yet another game that bears zero resemblance to the ads for it. I'm over 500 levels in and not seen anything remotely similar to the "stop the screen filling" gameplay they show in the ads: it's just another "match 3" clone. On the plus side, it is ad free, and you can absolutely play it without spending a penny on microtransactions; just that it's nothing remotely new. It's not bad, it's just... more of the same - and honestly, they really should be fined for false advertising

Nothing like the Advert - saw the video and sample play and it was nothing like it. Don't be fooled. You're not going to be chased by a dragon or anything. Got to build some stupid castle and towns. I mean the gameplay advert probably would have been better than what I experienced. One Star! and I'd give zero for false advertising.

Not good, continuously updates, less moves, I have been playing this game for a while they recently added a feature where you had 10 extra moves instead of 5 if you lost a life only for it to be taken away & there was nothing customer service could do. Disappointing.!! Limited to sending only 3 cards that you have worked hard to achieve, it's your cards you should be allowed to choose how much you send instead of being restricted. It takes forever to retrieve the gold cards. I could go on....

This game starts off great, really fun, (all designed to lure you in) but then slowly the pressure to buy resources creeps in, I got to level 128 pretty fast, but now the levels have gotten harder, which ruins it for me. The minute a game becomes more of a chore, its time for me to split. Shame as it started so good. My advice would be to play to level 100ish then delete.

The game itself is fun and a great time killer. The animations and art is good and the levels aren't too hard. I do find this to be false advertising however because of 2 major discrepancies. First, ads begin after every level once you reach level 20 so it most certainly is not ad free unless you pay. Second, it is not an offline game. I tested this by turning off data and disconnecting from wifi and the game does not play. It says I need to refresh my connection.

Another game that lies about "not being like the others" or "what's in the ad is what's in the game". The game does not resemble the ads, tells you it has "no ads" but forces you to watch one after every level and has a big "no ads" button on the home screen, which is a 7.99 purchase, and still shows ads afterwards! The "no WiFi required" selling point is also a lie. The game itself is basically a poor candy crush clone. Zero stars, uninstalled.

It took me just over a month to catch up to the devs on this game. Perfect runthrough, no lost lives; I'm impressed by my performance. Truly free to play, truly no ads. There are add-ons or you could spend money if you haven't amassed the resources at the early stages. It's good. The story mode updates with recurring events weekly and bigger stories monthly, and collections quarterly. I maxed out the Easter Diamond Bunny for my runthrough. Arena after you catch the soft cap is less engaging.

A reasonable match 3 colours game, but nothing like the advert. I get ads after every level, win or loose. I would download and play this game, but I wanted the one in the video ads. Watch those ads and you see the player is really stupid and can't match the colours, which suggests it is a game designed for stupid people. Download if you like Candy Crush, don't download if you like the video ads for Royal Kingdom.

No ads, like seriously not 1 single ad!! also no WiFi required to play either, they have mini challenges that do require WiFi because you play with others but in order to play this game no WiFi is needed or required. In terms of gameplay its simular to candy crush in that you match colours but this also has a story behind it that uncovers as you go along, you unlock advantages as you play while building your kingdom. Super addicting and relaxing, already at level 850.

The game is very addictive but it has a lot of issues. You can't see who is leaving alliance or joining unless you have the chat open. You can't see which players are online in real time, and the further you get, the more impossible it gets to pass the levels on purpose to make you spend money. All events are level passing related, so if you are stuck, there's no chance to get any coins or stuff to help you pass them, getting stuck level after level make it impossible to play and frustratig

I really wanted to like this and early on it would have been 5 stars. Game starts out great but it very quickly gets to a point where you can't beat levels without spending money. If my choices are pay money or delete the app, I'm deleting the app. This was also poor advertisement. I downloaded this game due to an ad from another game and it was nothing like that!! I wanted the game from the ad, not this! Another fail from the creators.

It's not as advertised with the king fighting to survive while you play. I went 4 rounds and it was just like every other game. This after clicking the ad because it blatantly types out in the ad that "this is the actual game, no lies" and then it isn't the actual game, and it IS lies. One day I hope someone makes a game like the ad, I'd like to play that instead of the same old thing.

This game looked promising and has good animation, but with the update the developers have made it Impossible to enjoy - just frstrating and a waste of your life. They reduced the lives you can have, by a third (ridiculous) and made the levels so hard, you spend hours or days trying to pass a level and wait for new lives. I've even paid for a kingdom pass and still can't get far, and I'm a seasoned player. They have ruined what was a good game.

As with all match 3 games it's nothing like the adverts, but it is fun! The game's algorithms are clearly (and somewhat unashamedly) aimed at getting you to spend money to progress and manipulate every part of the gameplay to try to make that happen. Success in most of the levels depends on whether the software will allow you an electroball at the critical moment. Enjoy it when you have a few minutes spare, treat it as a game of chance rather than skill and don't spend any actual money on it !!

I've played this game for weeks now but still can't find the levels which are advertised to make you download it? where are the games where you actually have to save the king from being crushed etc? Also they've made some levels impossible to complete then suddenly they " let" you win..probably to make you spend money on things which I never ever will do! Time to uninstall this mis- advertised game as its boring.

yet more false advertisment, where the game is nothing like the ads. several hundred levels in and at no point have I had to save the king from lava, falling rocks, snakes etc, whilst on the game board. it's just another simple match 3 game. I deleted this developers other royal match game purely for these same reasons of false advertisement of game play. I had hoped that maybe this one would be like advertised, sadly and disappointingly it's not.

Definitely pay to play and getting worse. purchased a pass but never get any free boosters. When you have you no boosters it can take you 1/2 days to complete levels. why would you purchase anything further if you cannot win a level playing with free lives and no boosters. once you make a purchase they have you, and you will not complete a level for a few days so you will pay to play on. The Royal pass is a waste of time. They make it impossible to progress.

This game is really boring and way too easy. You only see the mini games in advertising but you almost never get to play them and if you do they're also really boring and easy. These games try to make themselves more interesting by adding a bunch of random things to collect, like cards. What are those and why should I care? And what is the point of building random things in the kingdom? This is the same thing as a slot machine, lots of bright lights and noises but no substance.

I love that there are no ads and the game play is fun. I rated it low because I've gotten to a point where I have no coins, no power ups, and no way to get them but keep playing the same super hard level 30 times to maybe win ... or buy my way forward (I will not.) I just deleted the game. I play games for fun. Losing 30 times in one level is maddening not fun. If you want to enjoy a game more than a week, this isn't for you

This game is a nice upgrade from royal match and plays well with some fun graphics and better "building" options. lately though, it has felt so like the managers of the game have upped the difficulty and made it almost impossible to get to the 6 game winning streak. multiple levels have taken days to beat and time and again it feels like they just don't want to give up anything anymore. I know it's hard to walk the line between fun and challenging but this has gotten ridiculous lately.

As many have said, it reaches a point where it just isn't fun anymore and wants actual cash. Level 160-something for me. Edit here. Many others have spoken about how it's rigged. Playing other games I get saturation advertising for this. The game you download bears NO RELATION to the ads. Everything about this POS is fake, bordering on criminal.

This game is ok. I get no ads = the cost falls on us. And I will purchase things occasionally. However, since hitting the levels in the 2,000s range the game has become unplayable, unless I'm willing to spend a ton of $$$! At that point it is no longer enjoyable. I don't think I'll be playing this game much longer.

This game is very addictive. I have, however, noticed that the further into the game I get, the harder the challenges are to win over other players. I then noticed a player i was competing was on level 2 thousand and something but had over 4 thousand first-time wins on their scoreboard. Tells me the game is full of bots to stop too much progress without the use of real money. It would be good if new power ups were added like new challenges are. Its good for now but will get boring eventually.

it is decent in the beginning, but opens up to be a p2w game very quickly. some of the hard and super hard levels are beyond difficult with no strategy involved...it's all RNG. you can brick from a bad pull and placement of colors and lose everything. days of being stuck on the same level is by no means fun at all. with matches lasting seconds because you have so few moves and no chances to make power ups when the whole point of the match is to USE POWER UPS! 2 stars for graphics only.

I love this app game, but it keeps freezing up, I have to tap multiple times to get the screen working nearly after every level. I love this game because it doesn't have any advertisements at all. I have to uninstall it until this game is upgraded. I have to uninstall it for now. Thanks 👍

This game is a money grab. I refuse to pay so its all repetitive ads. If you have time to set phone down and come back once the ads have played out, or if you can waste money it can be fun. overall, not worth the money it would cost to gain the minor advantages money buys. The team plays aren't as much fun as I had hoped. The King Richard journey is the best part.

the game is exactly like what's in the pictures, well only for a while of you're online, the graphics are beautiful and the concept of building a kingdom after every level of winning is absolutely great! also there's no other way for someone like me to get coins unless I beat a level and the great part is that it's really playable even offline, great game if you're looking for a time skipper.

They should rebrand the game 'Match 3' since that's all you do 95% of the time. If you can accept that the algorithm is in control, it's an passable game to do nothing. Definitely not a time waster since at higher levels you only have a few tries to complete a level. Done in 5 mins, time for the average bowel movement.

advertised as a 'no ads' game, sure I can see having in game ads to get you to buy top ups and such, but the ad for the app itself is not even the actual gameplay. the 'adventure' part that looks like the ad, just looks like an afterthought to keep consumers happy. the game is addicting, but also misleading. you may find a better experience than I did, but I can't give this game more than 2 stars.

Definitely an addictive game to play. Unfortunately most of the levels aren't the ones that you see in the ads (the king pushing the wall to survive) although that is in the game but a very small part of it. I would have rated this game more than three stars but all the ads states that this game has no ads, however I have been receiving ads occasionally. Definitely not getting ads as frequently as other games but there are still ads. Still a fun game to play.

Started off fun, doable and addicting. but the more you play the more you have to spend to keep playing. it becomes impossibpe to defeat the further levels without a purchase. and they change how each item works towards the enemy figures! its not consistent. moves that would normally work to clear the board, now leaves me with a single enemy left over. thus forcing me to use my coins to continue. sneaky way to force purchases. not happy with this.

Used to be a lot of fun, but, as several people have already stated, you burn through power ups and coins faster than you can buy them. You get 20 coins on average for winning a level, but it takes 900 coins to continue. Unless you purchase more. It was a fun game, but at a point the levels get impossible to pass without spending money to buy more coins. Then, even you buy more coins, you have to use all of them to pass the next couple of levels.

Misleading ad for this game. I have seen so many ads for this game of the king running to avoid dangerous snakes or pits of death and in order to do so, the player must match things in order to provide escape. I took a chance and downloaded this game only to realize the gameplay is not what is advertised at all. Just match making gems/ items and leveling up the landscapes. HUGE DISAPPOINTMENT. UNINSTALLING.

Expertly designed to make you dependent on purchases. No ads & fast progression make the game desirable & fun. But after analyzing >700 levels, I can say with certainty this game changes on the move-by-move basis to sway you just enough to keep paying to keep playing. I was fine with this, I dont mind a small transaction here and there, even if algorithmically designed to do so. But after buying several of the lowest cost coin packs, they stopped allowing me to buy them. Last straw. Deleted.

It was a ton of fun, at first. Then it took me a week to pass one level because I had no power ups, no coins, and no lives. I'm not going to pay money just to pass a level. also, the photos for "What the game is like" is not what the game is AT ALL. Think Candy Crush but with shapes and occasionally levels where you have to match to hit certain things to pass the level. King Rescue is a game where you ACTUALLY save the king, but you're bombarded by ADs as you play

This is a Pay To Win game. You will start out with puzzles that are fairly easy, gets you a couple of hours of game play, but once you hit near level 200 you will start seeing puzzles or games that are near impossible to win without the perfect run. You will be encouraged to pay for boosts, bonus turns etc. in a never ending cycle of paying for in game currency. This is bejeweled with a different skin. TLDR: A rip off predatory game.

this game is super fun. the screenshots finally match up. There's STILL a huge bug where when you make a match to achieve a special move... the match just... disappears. This happens with an alarming and frustrating frequency. I'm going to keep playing the game, because it's that fun, but I don't trust it enough to make purchases at this time.

Game is just Bejeweled, but much worse. Everything in the game asks for money constantly. It's designed to ask you to spend more money every ten minutes. What do you get for this money, to play the game... The game is designed around you spending money to just play it, limited lives, pay to play power ups, card system, gem system, and levels designed to encourage you to spend more. It's a shame it's so sleepy.

After getting spammed by ads in another game I decided to download it.. surprise, surprise, its not like the ads at all.. also the screenshots on the app store pages are also the fake game.. which leads me to believe that most of the reviews here are also fake, since few of them actually mentioned this!.. also, if you have special items in play like the bomb, you can lose with "out of moves".. you should not be able to.If there are special items in play, as you can click to trigger them.

Disappointed. Game play is not at all as depicted in the teaser. You are expected to build castle features. There has not been any play like it is shown in the advertisement. Even after paying $7.99 to stop ads, my lives still time out, meaning I need to wait a certain amount of time until I can continue. I am not happy with the game. My wife has been playing Royal Match for years, and she has the same complaint on hers as well.

Another game falsely advertising what it is. The appeal to me was the ads, not another reskinned version of candy crush. I'm going to give it a few more levels, but probably won't stay much longer after that. Oh, and ads after nearly every level, especially if you fail to pass. EDIT: found the gameplay similar to the ads, but it's after level 29 and you have to complete so many levels before unlocking more of the journey..

It is glaringly obvious how the difficulty ranges from when you have no coins to when you have an abundance or, if you play well. Much worse, it seems, than what happens on Royal Match. "The game's algorithm and difficulty scaling are heavily tied to your progress, playing habits, and coin bank, rather than just your puzzle-solving skills." In other words, play well and the game plays against you.

Pay to Play - above the intro levels, it becomes difficult to impossible to succeed without purchases. It's 90% luck and 10% skill without paying. As an experiment, I played a high level (700-ish) without paying, and it took three days (probably 50+ tries) before I lucked out. But buy the coins and that level is easily solved with five or ten extra moves. Save your cash and look elsewhere.

I would love to give this game 5 stars, but unfortunately it has become nearly unplayable. I understand that developers need to make money, and I don't mind spending occasionally, but the game has reached a point where progress is extremely difficult unless you're constantly paying. The rewards are minimal and rarely feel worth the effort. The difficulty seems designed to push players into spending money rather than rewarding skill and persistence. A good game should be both fun and challenging.

I downloaded the game last night. I'm on level 34 currently, and after each level there is an ad for the same game, which forces you to go to the play store and prompts you to download the game. You have to exit out of both the play store and the ad before moving to the next round, just for the same thing to happen when you complete the round. At the start, there were no ads, but after getting ads evertime now, I'm done with the game. There's no need to force ads to get to the next round.

I gave this game a second try...the new ads for this game read the game has changed and the puzzles are real...well kind of...not the way they advertise it, and you have to win at regular levels (alot of levels) to even do the "puzzle" type levels. Again, false ads. Lastly, I shouldn't have to play a level 9,000 in order to pass it. I get it, not every level can be easy, but certain levels are just ridiculous. Uninstalled again...

Update to my review! Uninstalled! This game is only designed, with the intention to get a user to purchase items. These items help you last longer or progress further. You may last 2 out of 7 stages. Its algorithm assures that you cannot go further unless you purchase power up items. The patterns are consistent, never allowing a user to complete a full objective or challenge.

I played up to level 109 in spite of all the ads and constant push to spend money. I quickly noticed every time you start to build up resources the game will throw out an unbeatable pattern until your resources are gone then pushes buying more lives and resources. I tried to beat level 110 without resources but after running out of lives and waiting for more to accumulate 5 separate times I gave up and decided to write this review then delete the app. Don't waste your time on this one.

I kept seeing ads of this game everywhere so I decided to give it a try, I'm glad to say it's a nice free game to play with no ads and I'm currently at level 3360. it's a nice game. so I have a question, can you add a feature where players can chat with each other even from another team and also your friends and also a feature yo enable delete incorrect message. I would appreciate if you do so.

Good game, however at level 2000+ the game has become too difficult. It seems the game doesn't want us to play further: Powerups difficult to create, when created, are far from each other and can't be combined; Moves have become very limited; Difficulty in maintaining a three winning streak; Consumes coins and boosters for no reason etc. Super electro ball should go after at least 3 failed tries, moves should increase for moves and extra moves. 900 coins is too much for 5 extra moves. Thanks.

This game has always been a relaxing, play-anytime type of game that I have thoroughly enjoyed. Unfortunately, they just added timed competitions, which have taken away the leisure time aspect of the game that I am not enjoying. I understand the developers want to keep people playing constantly to improve their ROI, but some of us just want to relax in our own time.

started out good. got up to 150k coins and 75 each on items. in the past 2 months I lost all of it as the game has started to sabotage play. my friends have quit playing as you can't advance anymore without buying coins and items. the game seems to purposely not give you items when you match and if you use the items like the propeller it will target and destroy your lightball and make you have to pay to continue. I believe that most playersare AI. do NOT waste your time and money on this scam!!!

The game is not like the ads at all. That is what I signed up for, but instead I got a game that's exactly like every other match 3 game. All of the photos in the play store make it seem like the game in the ad, which is false advertising. I gave it a few levels and then uninstalled the game. It's too bad because the game in the ad looked fun.

New rule: if the ad that got me to try the game doesn't match the actual gameplay, you get 1 star. I'm so sick of it, and I would give negative stars if I could for not just showing gameplay that doesn't exist, but straight up lying by claiming it's NOT one of those ads showing fake gameplay. It's just another match-3 game that plays exactly the same as every other match-3 game.

I would have gave this game 5 stars, When I paid for the 30 days,for the monthly pass, it only gave me a few hours even though, I paid for it on the 1st of the month, I got cheated, out of my money. I won't be buying anything else. The game has great graphics, & it's fun to play. It's definitely a pay to play game.

NOT THIS ONE EITHER! Looking for a game that matches the ads with the guy in different cool scenarios trying to avoid catastrophe?..This Ain't it!...sorry...now to be clear it is definitely like they say, it is just like the ads, for 2 seconds, then its just like candy crush. no more crazy 'save the king scenarios' or cool levels getting him out of trouble. Just cc ...nothing more...so looking for the ad game that matches the ads...not this one either!!!

The ads are INCREDIBLY misleading! I would even go as far as to say they are a LIE! You aren't rescuing a king! Time is not of the essence. The levels that the ads show you aren't even actual game footage. None of that happens. None of that is real. It's a basic "merge 3" game. I will give it credit for not having any ads, though.

When I first started playing, it was good. Now that it updated, I can't see the extra lives and I can't get extra lives. I rarely get any lives when asking "friends" on the team. when I place my finger to make a move, half the time it doesn't do what I thought it would. Example, I thought I swiped right but piece goes left. The powers pieces doesn't help you anymore. I combined the bomb with the spin thing and it doesn't hit any of the targets. 3 times in a row I should win but I lose instead

Welp, it -was- a 5 star rated game for me until recently. I'm at level 233. The harder levels have become more frequent & impossible to beat, I've blown through coins & the ability to buy back into the game for more moves because I'm not earning enough coins now, & ironically at the same time that progress became almost impossible the offer of "get 5 more moves if you watch an Ad" has materialized. I have not updated the app & this happened within the last 15 levels. Deleting the app.

this is not the game In the ads. As Usual. it's a re skinned Candy Crush at best with some cool effects, but if you have come for the cool puzzle game with stakes- this doesn't exist. Not like in the ads at all. Just another rip off that makes you build a castle and grind. if that's what you're after, this game is for you. I however, am sorely disappointed.

It's a decent game. When you hit the highest level you have to manually update the game. It's almost impossible to beat at certain points without adding money to the game. If you want certain icons and frames, you're basically buying them. My team happens to be awesome so we all share and help one another. It's key to find a good team

Another game designed to get you to pay to pay, it allows you to play for a little while but you have "lives" that soon run out and unless you're willing to sign up with Facebook and pay to pay more, forget it. its another candy crush but limited so if you're after a game that you can play in very short intervals even off-line this is it.

All in all it's just another matching game. Except this one intentionally halts your progress to gain itself Ad Revenue. It'll always force a failure when you start a new level. Giving you no matches or chances for new openings without using power-ups (That of course cost real money outside of game related currency.) If you saw the Ad for it where you're saving the king. Thats a Mini-Game and has nothing to do with the gameplay otherwise. You unlock it via playing more levels.

classic case of bait and switch with respect to the ads for the game claiming it is ad free and completely free to play. it is only ad free for a very few number of levels, then you begin to encounter long ads for other games after each completed match that are hard to leave and never automatically take you back to the game you are playing. some ads just continuously loop and will not let you out. you are soon asked to pony up money to avoid the ads. i uninstalled. very annoying.

It is your pretty standard match puzzle game with the usual power-ups you see in similar games. It doesn’t really do anything new, but it works fine for what it is. If you fail a level enough times, the game starts giving you more power-ups, which makes it easier to get through. If you enjoy games like Toy Blast, you’ll probably like this too. Just don’t expect the gameplay shown in the ads because that’s not what this game is.

I initially downloaded this game because of an ad showing the main character trying to escape a snake in a cramped space. It looked fun and was the main reason I decided to try the game. I've had the game for months now, and none of the gameplay I've encountered is anything like what was shown in the advertisement. That was disappointing because it was the feature I was most interested in. The game itself is decent and worth trying, but I can't overlook the fact that the ad was misleading

Honestly, I was bought in by the ad for Richard's journey. Turns out that's not the main game. Disappointing. I just wanted to continuously use Match 3 to help him escape traps. The rest of the game is way too busy and flashy. On the plus side, I didn't see a single ad while playing.

I regret spending money on this game. It can be enjoyable, but it's full of issues the developers refuse to acknowledge. The game often says an ad isn't available when I try to earn free coins, yet seconds later loads an ad instantly when it wants me to watch one to continue playing. Support only provides generic responses instead of investigating. Be aware of the glitches and poor customer support before spending your money.

This is just candy crush with a lot of cosmetics. Gets super boring and requires tons of attempts to level up. The save the king bit is stupid, 30 seconds of the same loops over and over again. To get to play that you have to do tons of candy crush with increasingly ridiculous hard to break pieces. Basically holds you hostage in the hope you'll spend money on the game. Don't bother downloading.

The ads are partially false. It is a match 3 game like Candy Crush but not in the way like the ads show. Other than that its an ok game. There are no ads in the game, its free to play, you can buy things but are not forced to. Sometimes you get stuck but it just takes a few tries to get the right rng to clear the level.

I use to love this game. But now that I have surpassed level 3000 it seems you have buy the extra lives to advance. You can get coins by winning levels. But if you can't win the levels you can't get coins. They also have this card collecting game that you could win 10000 coins, but it also requires you to be able to win. My last 25 levels have been hard or super hard.

Been playing for many years and seen the game evolve. Unfortunately negatively. The current difficulty level is insane. You play the inhouse competitions that appear weekly in the hope of getting new gold cards, but nothing. What's the use then. All these things have one goal, to frustrate you and hope you will buy coins or boosters. It's become too much. Greedy developers. Shame on you.

it's a decent game I wanted to get to the part where you save the king and empty the rocks to see if you can save him from the snake that's not the case.. instead of looks like I'm building a kingdom and taken out the grass and making water go away. I wanted what I was saying advertised . that's why I gave it a three it's not a bad app.. but what it shows you is exciting. what you actually play is very dull. but it's free it's offline it's a Time passer

The game is supposed to be fun, but if they don't let you pass a level 40 times, it's not fun. If you don't pay, you won't get enough power ups for hours or days, and won't be able to pass the level. Also, power ups work differently every time. If they to let you pass the level, an electric ball with whirligigs produce e.g. 15 of them. If you are set to lose, you'll get about 5 in exactly same game, etc. You completely depend on their allowance, this game has nothing to do with your abilities.

This game is atrocious for trying to force you into paying money to complete levels. Every so often, you can get to having one thing left and you have no way to beat it other than to pay to receive more trys. This game definitely allows you to win to get you hooked, but every so often you can't really move on without paying. Pretty scummy move by the creators ...it's exactly why this is "ad free" - they loop in enough idiots willing to keep paying to play... should be illegal

Other games advertise it as there being no Ads. This is incorrect. After a few hours of play you'll increase ads you must pay to remove. The game is heavily skewed to making you pay to play with meager rewards that dont equate to much. For example, each level will net you 20 to 60 coins when it costs 900 coins per level to "revive" with five extra turns. Most the time this will not aid your success.

it's so fun and so loyal to the ads, you literally get exactly what the ads say, except that every two or three levels you get stuck with impossible tasks and 25 moves to work with or you can use 900 coins that you don't make in only two levels so you'd have to pay $2 every single time the level is too hard, which is a waste of money

I fell for it, I fell for the ads.... I enjoy the mini games in these Royal games. and the ad even claimed "no lies". it inferred every level was the fun mini games keeping the king from being brutally killed. alas, the ads did indeed lie. same games as it always was, low IQ pretty colors and animations that eventually you'll have to spend money to beat.

This game WOULD be fun, if it were consistently playable. But it's not. It's set up so that the only way to win challenges is with playing resources, but the only way to acquire those resources is by first winning challenges. Making it nearly impossible to play the game as a whole. Which leaves paying money for those resources as the only remaining option. It's a kind of a sleazy underhanded scam. Not everyone can afford to PAY to play phone games.

A good game should give the players an opportunity to stack up rewards, at least to a minimum, not the other way. The game is unplayable if you don't have coins to spend, and the only reasonable way to get enough coins to pay for more moves is by spending real money. Boring I'm at level "320" right now and I have never paid to play (nor do I intend on paying). But, here is why I will be deleting soon. The game is nothing like the ads. It lets you know somewhere in the game that the King rescue doesn't occur until around the level "1000". Now, the way around paying is tedious. You have to just keep declining to pay or use your 900 coins. Just start that level over from scratch. Eventually, the icons will all come down in the game and you'll beat the level.

Keep your game. It's way to difficult to earn anything and too difficult to win levels extremely early into the game. And the cost of game items to beat levels is extreme; takes your items quickly. I'll leave this game to the rich!! Uninstalling!!! After 2 hours of game play. It's not for me. Not all people can afford to pay to play!!!
Not a horrible game, but I played an hour and never saw the snake or the rubble puzzle or anything advertised in the ad. it's just another version of the Candy game.

Absolutely garbage. Typical scam app that lets you play for about a week and then the only way to pass the levels is to make purchases. Technically, you could rely on the "random" blocks to fall in your favor, but the game doesn't even hide the scam part. Suddenly, the levels start with like 9 blocks for you to play with and you only get a very limited number of moves. A few things to mention. it won't allow you to set up weapons. As the game goes on you can only use weapons to collect the required items which doesn't come easily. Then as the game goes on the cost to build anything is ridiculous with no real way to collect potions. Basically it's fun until the game takes over and only allows you to win when it wants you too. Toy Blast is a better game and it's free with no commercials either. I dont.think I will have this much longer.

Fun at first. Eventually, you'll find yourself stuck on the same level for days. What's relaxing about that? Can't make any real progress without spending money. Honestly, I'd rather see 15 second ad or have the option to watch one. You only win a handful of coins per level while it costs 900 to get only 5 more moves. Farm Heros is much more satisfying. There are no ads and I've never had to spend a dime on it.

False Advertising. I downloaded this app based on the ads where you're trying to save the king from being crushed. I played through 140 levels of this game, and none of the gameplay is like that. This is a pretty okay match-3 game, but the gameplay is more addictive than it is enjoyable. They give you story cutscenes early on, but these stop after you're far enough in. After this, it feels very same-y. I would have rated higher if not for the bait and switch. Please play a better game.

I downloaded this app hoping to find lots of puzzles to save the King. After not getting any levels anywhere near resembling the apps advertisements, I googled why I wasn't finding puzzles. Imagine my surprise and dismay, it seems these puzzles only appear every 100 levels or so. I immediately uninstalled the game. Without the puzzles as advertised, it's like any Matchb3 game.

Very well made game but expensive. Graphic & sound was highly polished. A fancy version of Candy Crush game. If you are good at Candy Crush games, you'll have no problem getting through the 1st 200 levels. After that, it will cost your 1,900 game coins to get 5 moves. Even with 76% off "discount offer" with final price US$7, only gets you 10,000 coins. That only last you 5 more games if your only need extra 5 moves to clear each level.

the game itself is really really fun and pretty addictive lol, with cute animations in the beginning. however, I'm only around level 150-200, and I'm getting stuck more and more, making the game less and less fun. heck, earlier I had tried using all my coins and power ups, was completely broke, and just couldn't have beat the level without paying real money. only through incredible luck did I manage after a 100 tries. if it doesn't get better, I'm probably gonna have to delete it :(

There are some elements of this game that make it better than it's predecessor, Royal Match. However, the same 2 major flaws still exist. The devs seem to think players think it is fun being stuck on levels for 50 or more lives. Hint, they don't! It only makes them uninstall. The 2nd flaw is the cost for 5 extra moves is way too high. Coins disappear fast, and then a player stays stuck for a long time yet again. It causes for a short lifespan on a user's phone. You need to listen to users devs.

Is it a good match 3 game? Sure. But I'm sick of games that advertise a particular gameplay, then barely fulfill it, if at all. Let me know when the game where you solve match 3 puzzles to save the king from danger releases. Otherwise stop lievertising to me. I mean I don't get it, obviously the scenes are in place, obviously the puzzles are set up. Why not give us what is advertised?

Fun to play in the beginning but I got stuck on level 40 something and I couldn't get past it without having to "buy" more moves. I didn't have enough in my chest and no way to get more without spending actual money. Other games offer ad viewing to acquire more coins. I understand "ad-free", which I appreciate but now I'm stuck with no way out 🤷‍♀️

Could be a really fun game, but has limited play unless you spend a lot of money to advance. Once you get to a certain point the levels become so ridiculously difficult you waste a lot of time playing the same level over and over again with no way to win. The packages from the store really do not offer much and you exhaust the items and coins too fast on difficult levels. It becomes monotonous very fast. Support says every level can be beat without power-ups. That is a load of 💩.

The Ads were misleading. Ads for this game pop up all over the place showing a 'Save the king' scenario where you save the king who's stuck in a tube with rocks or lava pouring through and you have to save him by doing a 'match 3+ shapes' puzzle. Thats why I wanted to download & play. Im up to level 135 and still haven't had any of those puzzles. Every game is a standard 'candy crush' style Match 3+ shapes game, but no 'save the king' challenges like what is advertised.

It's an OK game, but it cheats massively to force you to spend money to keep advancing through the levels. If you're disciplined, you can slog through while you wait for the algorithm to eventually serve enough power-ups to clear a level and move on, but few are. So no ads (good) but it will nickel-and-dime you to death (bad). Unless you want to spend a lot of money on it, really not worth it. Oh, and if you get stuck on a level, you can't uninstall and start over with a new username.

Very annoying. I've not even played this game yet, but it seems like a carbon copy of Royal Match. I literally downloaded it to write this review. It's Nothing like the ads. The ad is very repetitive and misleading and I'd rather not see it

This game is just a money grab. It advertised as a fun ad free game. when you get to upper levels there is literally no way to beat them without making in-app purchases. I have been stuck on the same level for days now and cannot get past it, and will not spend money to pass it. Play for free until you hit the impossible to beat levels then delete the game and move on.

So you know those ads where you see the gameplay, then you download the game and the game isn't anything like the ads?? THIS IS THAT GAME. All good until you get to approximately level 1800. I've been hooked on this game for quite a while now, but lately, it feels like the developers are cranking up the difficulty to an unreasonable degree. The game is great, and I appreciate No Ads! The only problem is, when you think you've got the puzzle solved, there's always, and I mean always, one item left to destroy. This game is ridiculous. There are multiple hard levels, then super hard levels all stacked one after the other. Unless you want to wait to receive power-ups, you have to spend money. eh...Started off really good. No ads, no begging for $. After level 1000, game gets silly. I deleted Royal match solely based on that ridiculousness. Well, true to the ads from other games, this game has no ads. It just haunts other apps, lol. I haven't been bugged to buy coins or anything, despite there being a shop to do so. That's refreshing. At this point, I can recommend this game. The main advertised draw—no ads—is nice. NOT being inundated with them is rare and appreciated.

The coins winnings is not worth the effort of getting through the levels. For example when you play a hard or super hard level you only get about 30 coins, and it's the same for the extra challenges. Additionally you only get 5 extra moves for the price of a lot of coins. This is not a game that I would consider spending money on due to the prizes and number of coin winnings being so low.

If you enjoy the match game only you'll like the game. However, if you're looking for the "rescue the king" as shown in the ads you will be disappointed. Apparently, it only comes up at certain levels and takes forever to get to them. Giving a low score for false advertising as the regular game is not as interesting as ads. Sad that the app can't allow the king play to be more often.

P2P. Typical match 3 game. The mini games advertised appear after level 1000 sporadically. Good luck getting that far. I am over level 2400. This game is rigged, and if you like being frustrated, and stuck on the same level for days, go for it. The Bi- Monthly Card quest does not give out enough Gold Cards to receive the prize.

I do not understand why game developers do this!!! The game itself is OK... and because of this i would give 2 stars. But the adverts for this game are false / fake / misleading / deceptive. Well... it indeed doesn't have ads. At least it has that going for it. Fun way to pass time when the game isn't trying to drain your wallet. They took me from 150k gold down to 10k in about 3 days. Why, because I just couldn't seem to finish a level without using gold. And they double the price every time you run out of moves. This game is a money pit. It's fun at first until you get to the harder levels. Then it becomes a gimmick to take your money to buy more coins. First let me repeat myself! The games that interrupt you are NOT what you get when they are downloaded. Two stars because I have yet to figure out the object of the game at the lower levels plus it's boring.

Im not gonna explain many things. Nice graphic and stages but if you don't pay it's not possible to pass the leves. The algorithm makes it difficult with the purpose to make you pay for the extra movements or extra materials. Simple it is! Avoid it, don't waste your time.

initially, when you're new to the game, it's fun. then it becomes predictable. 1. don't play the side games. you'll actually win them once every month or so. and when you do play them, you'll lose your first game automatically. 2. you'll get 30-60 minutes free time when you start each day. more often than not, the easy levels become extremely difficult levels and you'll spend that free time trying to beat that level. i get it. they want you to purchase coins or playing pieces. don't.

Whilst I do enjoy the game currently, there are no levels at all like the ads that pop up in every single other game... Major disappointment and false advertising! I'm sure I will get to a point in this one where I give up as well because it's just the same as the others. I've almost dwindled down all the coins I was able to earn in the early levels and I won't be paying to get more when the levels get unwinnable.

Worse than royal match if that can be possible. Levels fun until around level 150, then your money starts falling. Payments for each level are meager (20 coins or less)and only pay you at the end for the first explosion of bonuses left behind after completing a level. After that, any more explosions don't count. They created this game because most of the long-time players left Royal Match. Unistalling.

First off: false advertising. The gameplay shown in ads doesn't exist. Yet another game created to farm microtransactions. The first few hundred levels are fun and easy-ish to clear to get you invested. Then they become borderline impossible without using coins or boosters - which you have to buy, and I refuse to do so out of principle. Just how blatant it is left a bad taste in my mouth. Fun enough to play an afternoon or two, but beyond that...save yourself the frustration. And money.

the game itself is fine. it's just as good as royale match if you enjoy that kind of thing. but both games have the same flaw in that if you're looking for the levels that are in the commercials, tough. I gave this a thorough test and I'm well over level 1000 in each and have yet to see the levels in the commercial. I consider that very disappointing and misleading.

This game is fun, but predatory. After enjoying 100-200 levels, and then struggling through around 100 levels that seemed unfair, I unlocked a powerup that you can keep indefinitely until you drop a 10 win-streak combo, which actually made the game somewhat fair. But I just logged in today, and the combo was reset to 0... not sure if this is a bug or intended, but the levels are basically impossible without power-ups now. I refuse to whale, so I guess the fun is over... No ads, so it gets +1.

The game adds show an in-depth game with grade A animation and puzzle solving that incorporates this animation. So far this game is just one generic puzzle after another, that encourages the purchase of small boosts because levels limit your moves. This is more stressful, and not a relaxing game as you stress about limited moves. I am actually currently stuck on an impossible "boss" level without purchasing the power-ups.

This game is nothing like the advertisement for it, the advertisement is misleading. There aren't any puzzles like what you advertise. I downloaded it thinking it would be fun and not one single puzzle like what is advertised and I thought maybe after I get a few levels into the game that I'll see some of what was advertised but no you don't. It's just a block matching game with no king trying to get out smh. Thanks for wasting my time.

This app just showed up on my phone one day, and I said heck why not I'll give it a try. It really was very fun for the first few hours of gameplay! Eventually though you get to a point where you have to pay to win, and this app does not have the content to justify paying my hard earned money, just for a few power ups to get through otherwise impossible puzzles. 1 star easily just for that fact alone.

Not as advertised but still played because I like matching games and it's good to play offline. This game quickly became like their sister game. It's frustrating to play since levels became impossible to beat with the little moves they give you. You have to spend real money to get ahead in this game which I refuse to do! I'm very quickly loosing interest in playing.

Addictive game. However, it's now taking me days and sometimes weeks to beat levels, which is very frustrating. It's not fun having to play every level multiple times. I'm on level 199 and already tried it eight times, the previous level took me 2 weeks to beat. Also the hints are often in bad places that have caused me to lose levels several times because they were only getting me boosters instead of progressing through the level.

It's a good match-3 game, but I need to reduce the rating due to the deceptive advertising. After more than 150 levels I still haven't seen one that involves the rescue scenarios shown in every single ad. I know that it would be cost-prohibitive to make every level like that, but there should be an occasional level that utilizes the game mode if you're going to use it as the primary means of drawing in players.

Having no ads is great. However the game definitely goes out of its way to try and get you to spend money for more turns. It definitely forces you to lose matches later on and it'll feel like you're bashing your head on a brick wall and playing the same level 10-20 times before it "Let's you win" by finally spawning combos or playable moves.

it's just like every other match 3 game. the algorithm is to get you mad enough to buy power-ups. it's not being smart enough to beat the levels or how you match the pieces up. you will get stuck on levels for days or until you buy something in the game. if you have time to waste and dont mind not getting the event prizes cause you can't pass a level you'll be good. I have since deleted this game due to it being a pay to win method. I would give it no stars but have to give 1

The game itself has a lot of variety in the layouts and challenges of the match-3 levels, but the ads for this game show the king being threatened by a pile of rocks and we have to match 3 to clear a way for the rocks to be removed. I've played 200+ levels and haven't had that scenario. It feels like false advertising to show a scenario and not have it in the game.

I would give it five stars if the awarded coins amount increased when building a kingdom, because the cost to build only gets higher. This game sucks. There is no save the king levels as of yet. I am on level 260 something. Also the algorithm for losing levels is MUCH HIGHER than winning. I'm only keeping it for morbid curiosity to see how much more this game will suck in the uper levels if I ever get there. this is a fun game until you get to a certain level and you can tell that at that point it is completely geared at getting you to spend more money. it gets a bit frustrating, after a few weeks of seeing the same pattern play out, it's very obviously causing you to lose with only one move left to win and then giving you offers at that point. Fun for a while, until levels clearly become designed to screw you by 1 or 2 moves. "Multi-layer" ice is also misleading, requiring single squares to be hit twice to make any sort of progress. Disappointing. Why advertise the game as something then the actual game is something else?!! I don't wanna spend most of the time in a boring game where I use the coins to build something. An extremely frustrating game. So many levels are designed to have one left on the board forcing you to deplete your coins. so..this game starts off well..then around level 850 the ai starts to become apparent..you start to see patterns like you are only one move away from completing a level.. then next moment you will have spent all your coins and to complete that level spend 99p. this game could have been continually fun but unfortunately you can see the ideas behind it. get involvement. get them needing money and charge them. play till 700 800. then uninstall..shame really the no adds was a nice touch

I am really enjoying this game no commercials. It's exactly what it shows and most games have a catch to them. But this one I am having a pretty good time playing. not as advertised and not without ads. I would have given it 0 stars if possible. each level is the same old thing. nothing like it showed trying to get me to download it. lie on TV ads lied on game ads. too bad.

Royal Kingdom is Dream Games’ follow-up to Royal Match, and it feels very similar in a lot of ways. It’s still a match‑3 puzzle game with that smooth, polished engine they’re known for, plus great visuals and a clean interface. The big difference? Instead of decorating rooms like in Royal Match, you’re rebuilding an entire kingdom. There’s also this “Attack Levels” feature where you defend King Richard from the Dark King, which adds a nice twist and breaks up the usual pattern.
It's more like Candy Crush than what you see in the ads. I've never once had to save the king from crushing rocks or burning lava. I'm up to level 1,002. Lava aside, it's a fun way to kill time.
